title: Complete Blender/Unreal beginner, day 4: GPT-6 Astra building a playable Overlook corridor through MCP [Unreal + Blender]
author: Time-Ad-7720
selftext:
I asked ChatGPT to turn Danny’s tricycle ride from *The Shining* into a playable demo using Blender MCP and Unreal MCP. This is where the experiment is after about four days.

For clarity: the main build was handled by GPT-6 Astra. I’m supplying references, giving feedback, and playtesting. I’d never used Blender or Unreal before this.

There’s now a rideable corridor, a modeled Danny and tricycle, lighting, and a soundtrack. It’s taken a lot of iteration—camera flips, weird steering, and visual details that needed several attempts.

Definitely an unfinished prototype. Curious what stands out most in the footage as needing improvement, especially the scale, lighting, or camera.
